module Test where

import DA.Set as S
import Daml.Script
import Governance

data Fixture = Fixture with
  government : Party
  x : Party
  y : Party
  z : Party
  citizens : Set Party
  name : Text

fixture : Script Fixture
fixture =
  do
    government <- allocateParty "Government"
    x <- allocateParty "A"
    y <- allocateParty "B"
    z <- allocateParty "C"
    let citizens = S.fromList [ x, y, z ]
    let name = "TestBallot"
    pure Fixture with ..

acceptBallot : Fixture -> Proposal -> Script DecisionOutcome
acceptBallot Fixture{..} proposal =
  do
    let ballot = Ballot with government; name; proposal; voters = S.empty; voted = S.empty; votes = []
    let ballotKey = key ballot
    submit government do createCmd ballot
    submit government do exerciseByKeyCmd @Ballot ballotKey Add with voter = x
    submit government do exerciseByKeyCmd @Ballot ballotKey Add with voter = y
    submit government do exerciseByKeyCmd @Ballot ballotKey Add with voter = z
    submit x do exerciseByKeyCmd @Ballot ballotKey Vote with voter = x; accept = True
    submit y do exerciseByKeyCmd @Ballot ballotKey Vote with voter = y; accept = True
    submit z do exerciseByKeyCmd @Ballot ballotKey Vote with voter = z; accept = False
    submit government do exerciseByKeyCmd @Ballot ballotKey Decide

assertConstitution : DecisionOutcome -> Script (ContractId Constitution)
assertConstitution outcome =
  case outcome of
    None -> fail "Expected Some outcome, got None"
    Some either ->
      case either of
        Left constitutionId -> pure constitutionId
        _ -> fail "Expected Left (ContractId Constitution), got Right"

assertConstitutionV2 : DecisionOutcome -> Script (ContractId ConstitutionV2)
assertConstitutionV2 outcome =
  case outcome of
    None -> fail "Expected Some outcome, got None"
    Some either ->
      case either of
        Right constitutionId -> pure constitutionId
        _ -> fail "Expected Right (ContractId ConstitutionV2), got Left"

-- Vote to create constitution
voteCreateConstitution' = voteCreateConstitution =<< fixture

voteCreateConstitution fixture@Fixture{..} = script do
  let proposal = CreateConstitution (Constitution with government; citizens; text = "Constitution Text v1"; version = 1)
  outcome <- acceptBallot fixture proposal
  constitutionId <- assertConstitution outcome
  Some constitution <- queryContractId government constitutionId
  assert $ constitution.text == "Constitution Text v1"
  assert $ constitution.version == 1
  pure constitutionId

-- Vote to update constitution text
voteUpdateConstitutionText' = voteUpdateConstitutionText =<< fixture

voteUpdateConstitutionText fixture@Fixture{..} = script do
  constitutionId <- voteCreateConstitution fixture
  let proposal = UpdateConstitutionText (constitutionId, "Constitution Text v1.1")
  outcome <- acceptBallot fixture proposal
  constitutionId <- assertConstitution outcome
  Some constitution <- queryContractId government constitutionId
  assert $ constitution.text == "Constitution Text v1.1"
  assert $ constitution.version == 1
  pure constitutionId

-- Vote to ugrade constitution contract
voteUpgradeConstitution' = voteUpgradeConstitution =<< fixture
voteUpgradeConstitution fixture@Fixture{..} = script do
  constitutionId <- voteUpdateConstitutionText fixture
  let proposal = UpgradeConstitution constitutionId
  outcome <- acceptBallot fixture proposal
  constitutionV2Id <- assertConstitutionV2 outcome
  Some constitutionV2 <- queryContractId government constitutionV2Id
  assert $ constitutionV2.text == "Constitution Text v1.1"
  assert $ constitutionV2.version == 2
  pure constitutionV2Id

-- Create a new ballot off ConstitutionV2
-- We can create the ballot and all voting rights right away using the signatures on ConstitutionV2
createNewBallotOffConstitution' = createNewBallotOffConstitution =<< fixture
createNewBallotOffConstitution fixture@Fixture{..} = script do
  constitutionV2Id <- voteUpgradeConstitution fixture
  -- Now we can create new ballots and voting rights right off the constitution having everyone's signature there
  let proposal = CreateConstitution (Constitution with government; citizens; text = "Constitution Text v3"; version = 1)
  submit government do exerciseCmd constitutionV2Id CreateBallot with name = "NewBallot"; proposal

allScripts = do
  fixture <- fixture
  voteCreateConstitution fixture
  voteUpdateConstitutionText fixture
  voteUpgradeConstitution fixture
  createNewBallotOffConstitution fixture

module Test where

import Daml.Script
import qualified DA.Set as S
import Governance

ballotByName : Party -> Text -> Script (ContractId Ballot, Ballot)
ballotByName government name = do
  ballots <- query @Ballot government
  case filter (\(_, ballot) -> ballot.name == name) ballots of
    [found] -> pure found
    _ -> abort "Expected exactly one active ballot"

approveTwo : Party -> Party -> Party -> Text -> Proposal -> Script DecisionOutcome
approveTwo government alice bob name proposal = do
  ballotId <- submit government do createCmd (Ballot with government; name; proposal; voters = S.fromList [alice, bob]; voted = S.empty; votes = [])
  submit alice do exerciseCmd ballotId Vote with voter = alice; accept = True
  (firstId, _) <- ballotByName government name
  submit bob do exerciseCmd firstId Vote with voter = bob; accept = True
  (secondId, _) <- ballotByName government name
  submit government do exerciseCmd secondId Decide

rejectOne : Party -> Party -> Text -> Proposal -> Script DecisionOutcome
rejectOne government alice name proposal = do
  ballotId <- submit government do createCmd (Ballot with government; name; proposal; voters = S.singleton alice; voted = S.empty; votes = [])
  submit alice do exerciseCmd ballotId Vote with voter = alice; accept = False
  (votedId, _) <- ballotByName government name
  submit government do exerciseCmd votedId Decide

testExecuteProposals : Script ()
testExecuteProposals = do
  government <- allocateParty "government"
  alice <- allocateParty "alice"
  bob <- allocateParty "bob"
  let citizens = S.fromList [alice, bob]
  let constitution = Constitution with government; citizens; text = "initial"; version = 7
  created <- approveTwo government alice bob "create" (CreateConstitution constitution)
  initialId <- case created of
    Some (Left cid) -> pure cid
    _ -> abort "Creation must return a Constitution ID"
  initial <- queryContractId government initialId
  assert (initial == Some constitution)
  updated <- approveTwo government alice bob "update" (UpdateConstitutionText (initialId, "revised"))
  updatedId <- case updated of
    Some (Left cid) -> pure cid
    _ -> abort "Update must return a Constitution ID"
  assert (updatedId /= initialId)
  archived <- queryContractId government initialId
  assert (archived == None)
  current <- queryContractId government updatedId
  assert (current == Some (constitution with text = "revised"))
  upgraded <- approveTwo government alice bob "upgrade" (UpgradeConstitution updatedId)
  v2Id <- case upgraded of
    Some (Right cid) -> pure cid
    _ -> abort "Upgrade must return a ConstitutionV2 ID"
  old <- queryContractId government updatedId
  assert (old == None)
  new <- queryContractId government v2Id
  assert (new == Some (ConstitutionV2 with government; citizens; text = "revised"; version = 8))
  declinedCreate <- rejectOne government alice "declined-create" (CreateConstitution constitution)
  assert (declinedCreate == None)
  declinedUpdate <- rejectOne government alice "declined-update" (UpdateConstitutionText (initialId, "wrong"))
  assert (declinedUpdate == None)
  declinedUpgrade <- rejectOne government alice "declined-upgrade" (UpgradeConstitution initialId)
  assert (declinedUpgrade == None)
  unchanged <- queryContractId government v2Id
  assert (unchanged == new)

testVotingAndDecision : Script ()
testVotingAndDecision = do
  government <- allocateParty "government"
  alice <- allocateParty "alice"
  bob <- allocateParty "bob"
  charlie <- allocateParty "charlie"
  outsider <- allocateParty "outsider"
  let citizens = S.fromList [alice, bob, charlie]
  let constitution = Constitution with government; citizens; text = "voted text"; version = 1
  ballotId <- submit government do createCmd (Ballot with government; name = "creation"; proposal = CreateConstitution constitution; voters = citizens; voted = S.empty; votes = [])
  submitMustFail government do exerciseCmd ballotId Decide
  submitMustFail outsider do exerciseCmd ballotId Vote with voter = outsider; accept = True
  submitMustFail alice do exerciseCmd ballotId Vote with voter = outsider; accept = True
  submitMustFail government do exerciseCmd ballotId Vote with voter = government; accept = True
  submit alice do exerciseCmd ballotId Vote with voter = alice; accept = True
  (firstId, first) <- ballotByName government "creation"
  assert (first.voted == S.singleton alice)
  assert (first.votes == [True])
  assert (first.voters == citizens)
  submitMustFail alice do exerciseCmd firstId Vote with voter = alice; accept = False
  submitMustFail government do exerciseCmd firstId Decide
  submit bob do exerciseCmd firstId Vote with voter = bob; accept = False
  (secondId, second) <- ballotByName government "creation"
  assert (second.voted == S.fromList [alice, bob])
  assert (second.votes == [False, True])
  submitMustFail government do exerciseCmd secondId Decide
  submit charlie do exerciseCmd secondId Vote with voter = charlie; accept = True
  (thirdId, third) <- ballotByName government "creation"
  assert (third.voted == citizens)
  assert (third.votes == [True, False, True])
  submitMustFail alice do exerciseCmd thirdId Decide
  result <- submit government do exerciseCmd thirdId Decide
  newId <- case result of
    Some (Left cid) -> pure cid
    _ -> abort "Majority acceptance must create a constitution"
  new <- queryContractId government newId
  assert (new == Some constitution)
  ballots <- query @Ballot government
  assert (null ballots)

testTiesAndRejectedProposals : Script ()
testTiesAndRejectedProposals = do
  government <- allocateParty "government"
  alice <- allocateParty "alice"
  bob <- allocateParty "bob"
  let constitution = Constitution with government; citizens = S.fromList [alice, bob]; text = "no"; version = 1
  ballotId <- submit government do createCmd (Ballot with government; name = "tie"; proposal = CreateConstitution constitution; voters = S.fromList [alice, bob]; voted = S.empty; votes = [])
  submit alice do exerciseCmd ballotId Vote with voter = alice; accept = True
  (firstId, _) <- ballotByName government "tie"
  submit bob do exerciseCmd firstId Vote with voter = bob; accept = False
  (tieId, _) <- ballotByName government "tie"
  submitMustFail government do exerciseCmd tieId Decide
  constitutions <- query @Constitution government
  assert (null constitutions)
  (activeId, _) <- ballotByName government "tie"
  assert (activeId == tieId)
  rejectId <- submit government do createCmd (Ballot with government; name = "rejection"; proposal = CreateConstitution constitution; voters = S.fromList [alice]; voted = S.empty; votes = [])
  submit alice do exerciseCmd rejectId Vote with voter = alice; accept = False
  (votedId, _) <- ballotByName government "rejection"
  outcome <- submit government do exerciseCmd votedId Decide
  assert (outcome == None)
  after <- query @Constitution government
  assert (null after)
  charlie <- allocateParty "charlie"
  mixedId <- submit government do createCmd (Ballot with government; name = "minority"; proposal = CreateConstitution constitution; voters = S.fromList [alice, bob, charlie]; voted = S.empty; votes = [])
  submit alice do exerciseCmd mixedId Vote with voter = alice; accept = True
  (oneId, _) <- ballotByName government "minority"
  submit bob do exerciseCmd oneId Vote with voter = bob; accept = False
  (twoId, _) <- ballotByName government "minority"
  submit charlie do exerciseCmd twoId Vote with voter = charlie; accept = False
  (threeId, _) <- ballotByName government "minority"
  minorityResult <- submit government do exerciseCmd threeId Decide
  assert (minorityResult == None)
  finalConstitutions <- query @Constitution government
  assert (null finalConstitutions)

testUpgradeAndBallotManagement : Script ()
testUpgradeAndBallotManagement = do
  government <- allocateParty "government"
  alice <- allocateParty "alice"
  bob <- allocateParty "bob"
  charlie <- allocateParty "charlie"
  let citizens = S.fromList [alice, bob]
  originalId <- submitMulti [government, alice, bob] [] do createCmd (Constitution with government; citizens; text = "old"; version = 3)
  submitMustFail government do exerciseCmd originalId UpdateText with newText = "unauthorized"
  updatedId <- submitMulti [government, alice, bob] [] do exerciseCmd originalId UpdateText with newText = "new"
  upgradeId <- submitMulti [government, alice, bob] [] do createCmd ConstituationUpgrade with government; citizens
  submitMustFail government do exerciseCmd upgradeId Execute with constitutionId = updatedId
  v2Id <- submitMulti [government, alice, bob] [] do exerciseCmd upgradeId Execute with constitutionId = updatedId
  v2 <- queryContractId government v2Id
  assert (v2 == Some (ConstitutionV2 with government; citizens; text = "new"; version = 4))
  submitMustFail alice do exerciseCmd v2Id CreateBallot with name = "law"; proposal = UpgradeConstitution originalId
  key <- submit government do exerciseCmd v2Id CreateBallot with name = "law"; proposal = CreateConstitution (Constitution with government; citizens; text = "law"; version = 1)
  assert (key == (government, "law"))
  (ballotId, ballot) <- ballotByName government "law"
  assert (ballot.voters == citizens)
  assert (ballot.voted == S.empty)
  assert (ballot.votes == [])
  submitMustFail government do exerciseCmd v2Id CreateBallot with name = "law"; proposal = UpgradeConstitution originalId
  submitMustFail alice do exerciseCmd ballotId Add with voter = charlie
  submit government do exerciseCmd ballotId Add with voter = charlie
  (_, expanded) <- ballotByName government "law"
  assert (expanded.voters == S.insert charlie citizens)
  assert (expanded.voted == S.empty)
  assert (expanded.votes == [])
  (expandedId, _) <- ballotByName government "law"
  submit charlie do exerciseCmd expandedId Vote with voter = charlie; accept = True
  (votedId, votedBallot) <- ballotByName government "law"
  assert (votedBallot.voters == S.insert charlie citizens)
  assert (votedBallot.voted == S.singleton charlie)
  assert (votedBallot.votes == [True])
  submitMustFail government do exerciseCmd votedId Decide
  newerId <- submitMulti [government, alice, bob] [] do exerciseCmd v2Id UpgradeV2 with newText = "latest"
  old <- queryContractId government v2Id
  assert (old == None)
  newer <- queryContractId government newerId
  assert (newer == Some (ConstitutionV2 with government; citizens; text = "latest"; version = 4))
